repairs.quote: Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow. If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take (60/90/120/150/180 + (30% Ability Power) + (3% bonus Health)) magic damage and are briefly Slowed. Slows by 40%. Maximum magic damage: (120/180/240/300/360 + (60% Ability Power) + (6% bonus Health)).
